rules.title: Source of Income Discrimination Prohibition
rules.citation: Cal. Fair Employment and Housing Act (FEHA)
rules.quote: California law protects tenants from discrimination based on how a tenant will be paying rent ("source of income"). This includes the State of California's COVID-19 Rent Relief Program, Housing Choice (Section 8) vouchers, (SSI) social security disability benefits, or wages earned from a job.
rules.summary: Housing providers in California cannot discriminate against tenants based on their source of income, including Section 8 vouchers, SSI benefits, rental assistance programs, or wages.
rules.coverage_text: Applies to most providers of housing and services related to housing such as landlords, tenant screening companies, real estate agents, home sellers, builders, mortgage lenders, and housing authorities
rules.exemption_note: When an owner is occupying a home and is renting to one additional person, the owner may exclude applicants based on protected characteristics

rules.title: Criminal History Screening Restrictions
rules.citation: Cal. Fair Employment and Housing Act (FEHA)
rules.quote: Housing providers cannot consider some types of criminal history including arrests that did not lead to a conviction, records that are sealed or expunged, or records or matters processed in the juvenile justice system. Housing providers are also prohibited from having "blanket bans" of all people with a criminal history.
rules.summary: Housing providers cannot consider arrests without convictions, sealed or expunged records, or juvenile records, and cannot have blanket bans on all people with criminal histories.
rules.coverage_text: Applies to most providers of housing and services related to housing such as landlords, tenant screening companies, real estate agents, home sellers, builders, mortgage lenders, and housing authorities
rules.exemption_note: When an owner is occupying a home and is renting to one additional person, the owner may exclude applicants based on protected characteristics
